name: Barbell Back Squat
shortCueText: Drive knees out, keep chest proud, hit parallel.

name: Bodyweight Squat
shortCueText: Sit hips back as if onto a chair, weight in midfoot.

name: Goblet Box Squat
shortCueText: Touch box lightly without relaxing tension.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
shortCueText: Keep dumbbell tight to collarbone, elbows inside knees.

name: 45° Leg Press
shortCueText: Feet shoulder-width on carriage, lower back pressed firm.

name: Machine Hack Squat
shortCueText: Smooth descent, drive through midfoot.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
shortCueText: Front knee tracks over second toe, lean slightly forward.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
shortCueText: Step back softly, keep 90° angles in both knees.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
shortCueText: Push hips back like closing a door, soft knee bend.

name: Dumbbell RDL
shortCueText: Keep dumbbells grazing your shins, flat neutral spine.

name: Conventional Barbell Deadlift
shortCueText: Pull slack out of bar, drive floor away with legs.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
shortCueText: Neutral grip, upright torso, push floor away.

name: Seated Leg Extension Machine
shortCueText: Pause 1 sec at top, controlled negative.

name: Seated Leg Curl Machine
shortCueText: Drive heels back toward seat, controlled stretch.

name: Lying Leg Curl Machine
shortCueText: Keep hips pinned to pad throughout range.

name: Standing Calf Raise
shortCueText: Full stretch at bottom, rise onto big toes at top.

name: Seated Calf Raise
shortCueText: Pause in deep stretch for 2 seconds before contraction.

name: Standard Push-Up
shortCueText: Plank posture, elbows at 45 degrees, chest to floor.

name: Incline Push-Up (Bench)
shortCueText: Hands on elevated bench, easier leverage for clean form.

name: Barbell Bench Press
shortCueText: Pinch shoulder blades, touch mid-sternum, drive up.

name: Flat Dumbbell Press
shortCueText: Slight arch, rotate dumbbells slightly inward for joint comfort.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
shortCueText: Bench at 30 degrees, press up and converge softly.

name: Incline Chest Press Machine
shortCueText: Handles at upper chest level, stable back support.

name: Seated Chest Press Machine
shortCueText: Smooth rhythm, avoid snapping elbows at lock-out.

name: Pec Deck / Butterfly Machine
shortCueText: Lead with elbows, squeeze chest in the center.

name: Standing Cable Fly / Crossover
shortCueText: Slight torso lean, bring handles together like hugging a tree.

name: Machine Assisted Chest Dip
shortCueText: Lean torso forward 15 degrees, lower to 90 degree elbow bend.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
shortCueText: Hinge to 45 degrees, pull bar to belly button, squeeze lats.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar / Dumbbell Row
shortCueText: Chest flat on incline pad, zero lower-back strain.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
shortCueText: Support hand on bench, pull dumbbell to pocket.

name: Cable Lat Pulldown
shortCueText: Pull bar to upper chest, drive elbows down and back.

name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
shortCueText: V-bar handle, joint-friendly shoulder tracking.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
shortCueText: Depress shoulder blades first, pull chest to bar.

name: Seated Cable Row
shortCueText: Sit tall, pull handle into lower ribs, avoid rocking.

name: Standing Cable Straight-Arm Pulldown
shortCueText: Slight torso hinge, sweep bar down in an arc with straight arms.

name: Cable Face Pull
shortCueText: Rope attachment, pull to eye level and rotate hands back.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
shortCueText: Back supported, press overhead in the scapular plane.

name: Standing Barbell Overhead Press (OHP)
shortCueText: Glutes tight, bar clears chin, press to lockout overhead.

name: Seated Machine Shoulder Press
shortCueText: Neutral grip handles reduce front shoulder impingement.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
shortCueText: Raise to shoulder height slightly in front of body.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
shortCueText: Constant tension throughout entire range of motion.

name: Reverse Pec Deck (Rear Delts)
shortCueText: Keep arms almost straight, sweep back without shrugging.

name: Standing Dumbbell Biceps Curl
shortCueText: Pin elbows to side, curl and supinate wrist at peak.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
shortCueText: Neutral palms-facing grip, targets brachialis and forearm.

name: Incline Bench Dumbbell Curl
shortCueText: Lie on 60° incline, long head stretch at bottom.

name: Preacher Curl Machine
shortCueText: Armpits over top pad, full isolation without swinging.

name: Cable Biceps Curl
shortCueText: Straight bar or rope, constant resistance throughout.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown (Rope)
shortCueText: Elbows pinned to ribs, spread rope ends at bottom.

name: Cable Straight-Bar Triceps Pushdown
shortCueText: Overhand grip, press straight down to full extension.

name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
shortCueText: Lean forward, stretch long head behind neck, extend arms.

name: EZ-Bar Lying Triceps Extension
shortCueText: Lower bar toward hairline, extend forearms upward.

name: Forearm Plank
shortCueText: Elbows under shoulders, ribs down, squeeze glutes.

name: Deadbug
shortCueText: Press lower back firmly into floor as opposing limbs extend.

name: Cable Diagonal Woodchopper
shortCueText: Rotate from hips and core, keep arms long.

name: Cable Pallof Anti-Rotation Press
shortCueText: Stand sideways to cable, press hands straight out without twisting.

name: Hanging Knee / Leg Raise
shortCueText: Curl pelvis upward, avoid swinging momentum.

name: Lying Reverse Crunch
shortCueText: Roll hips off ground toward ribs, slow eccentric descent.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout (From Knees)
shortCueText: Tuck tailbone, roll out only as far as back stays flat.

name: Kettlebell Swing
shortCueText: Hinge at hips, snap glutes to standing, arms act as ropes.

name: Dumbbell Farmer Walk
shortCueText: Stand tall, walk with controlled heel-to-toe stride.
